request.prompt: Photorealistic macro product film, one continuous shot, bright warm studio daylight on a seamless warm off-white background. The camera drifts slowly across the powder, then rises and pulls back smoothly to reveal that the powder is a level scoop: a plain white measuring scoop held perfectly still above an open, plain, matte white supplement jar seen from slightly above. A few grains fall from the scoop into the jar. Soft natural shadows, clean and appetizing, calm pace. No hands, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no cuts.
